commits.message: fix(db): aiofiles optional import fallback + threadpool sync fallback
fix(deps): add DB retry/backoff and service_status tracking
fix(health): return partial status and avoid 503 when degraded
fix(auth): add cookie_flags helper and ensure session persisted before cookie set
fix(server): add global exception handler to return structured JSON instead of 500 stack traces

aiofiles_import_error.solution: Added optional import with try/except wrapper and async/sync fallback using threadpool
aiofiles_import_error.impact: Prevents ModuleNotFoundError crashes when aiofiles not installed

database_connection_failures.solution: Added retry logic with exponential backoff (3 attempts) and service status tracking
database_connection_failures.impact: Server continues running even if DB temporarily unavailable

health_endpoint_503_errors.solution: Changed /api/health/detailed to always return 200 OK with partial service status instead of 503
health_endpoint_503_errors.impact: Frontend health checks don't fail when individual services degraded

oauth_cookie_configuration.solution: Added cookie_flags() helper with environment-aware secure/samesite settings
oauth_cookie_configuration.impact: Cookies work correctly in dev (http) and prod (https) environments

session_persistence.solution: Ensured user saved to DB before setting auth cookie in OAuth callback
session_persistence.impact: Reduces race condition where /api/me fails because session not yet persisted

unhandled_500_errors.solution: Added global exception handler that returns structured JSON and logs to file
unhandled_500_errors.impact: Production doesn't leak stack traces; errors logged for diagnosis

service_status_tracking.description: Global service_status dict tracks mongo, arango, llm, json_fallback status with timestamps

llm_provider_fallback.behavior: Sets status to 'degraded' if init fails; system continues without LLM

pydantic_version.recommendation: Currently using mixed v1/v2 - pin to pydantic==1.10.12 or upgrade models to v2 ConfigDict style
pydantic_version.reason: No immediate breakage observed; defer to avoid regression risk

health_endpoint_write_tests.recommendation: Add lightweight DB write-read checks with cooldown to verify DB writability
health_endpoint_write_tests.reason: Current implementation only checks connection, not write capability

llm_fallback_provider.recommendation: Create FallbackLLM class that returns structured placeholders when real provider fails
llm_fallback_provider.reason: Currently just logs warning; endpoints would still fail if they require LLM

next_steps.1_user_testing: User should test OAuth flow end-to-end in browser
next_steps.2_db_verification: Verify MongoDB and ArangoDB writes succeed via /api/session/new
next_steps.3_production_deployment: Test with ENVIRONMENT=production and HTTPS frontend
next_steps.4_merge: Merge fix/runtime-hardening-20251011T113136Z to main after validation
